full_name: Fern Silva | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Bennington College
bio: Fern Silva’s films juxtapose the structures and industries of globalism. He is drawn to subjects that defy national identity through mythology, mysticism, and historical accounts, and his films consider uncanny and animistic approaches to narrative, ethnographic, and documentary filmmaking as the starting point for structural experimentation.
